scripts.//dev: device starts both radios; ble and wifi narrow it to one, and every hardware server also has the home network and HTTPS. Without :write every write is refused.
scripts.//watch: --watch, not --hot. --hot re-runs the code inside the same process and nothing closes the previous run's sockets, radio or timers. --watch restarts the process, so the OS releases all of it. The MQTT broker is not in this process at all: it runs detached (packages/transports/mqtt) and survives every restart, so the station stays connected.
scripts.//start: Not a dev server: no --watch, so the process does not restart under you. Both radios, and writes are ALLOWED.
